title: The Coral Sea (book)
text: The Coral Sea is a book by Patti Smith, published in 1996. In 2008 Smith released "The Coral Sea" as an album with musical accompaniment by Kevin Shields of My Bloody Valentine, recorded during two live performances of the duo.

title: Cool Kids of Death
text: The Cool Kids of Death are a Polish alternative rock band formed in Łódź in 2001. Their name comes from a Saint Etienne song.

title: Juan Alderete
text: Juan Alderete de la Peña (born September 5, 1963) is a Mexican-American musician, best known as the longtime bassist of Racer X and The Mars Volta.
